WA X is an independent open-source Xposed module and a fork/continuation of Dev4Mod/WaEnhancer. This fork is developed and maintained by Alaa. It hooks WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business at runtime; compatibility varies by target version.

1. Install a compatible Xposed environment such as LSPosed.
2. Download the WA X module APK from GitHub Releases (or Beta Testing for development builds).
3. Install WA X and enable the module.
4. Scope WhatsApp and/or WhatsApp Business.
5. For the current bridge, also include System Framework (android) and Settings Provider (com.android.providers.settings) when your Xposed manager exposes explicit package scope.
6. Restart the target app after changing hook-sensitive settings.
Community support: @WAXposed. Report reproducible bugs through GitHub Issues. Direct contact: @Alaa91h or alahus2591@gmail.com. Development support is voluntary through Ko-fi.

Runs atomic checks on the module, the runtime and its resolvers. A check without evidence is reported as not tested, never as working. End-to-end privacy behaviour needs a second account and is never confirmed automatically.
